It is consistent with the PSA model (Probabilistic Safety Assessment). The risk monitor provides the ability to easily examine past operating practices, current plant conditions, and future planned activities (e.g., maintenance schedules). This is accomplished by providing an easy-to-use interface that is consistent with terminology and nomenclature familiar to the staff. It makes the PSA model and resulting insights available to non-PSA analysts. The result is a staff who is risk aware and more thoroughly considers impacts to safety from its past, current, and planned activities.

articleTitle: Robust digital regulator for railway battery charging station
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper describes control algorithm of step-down DC/DC convertor for battery charging and diagnostic station. Because of high currents up to 100Amp and high number of connectable cells driven independently by two-step balancer, high level of stability of charging/discharging current and voltage transient response is required. Appropriate improvements of conventional discrete proportional-integral regulator algorithm are proposed, discussed and evaluated. Conclusion contains measured transient responses of described regulator during common operation.

articleTitle: Equilibrium thorium fuel loading in VVER-1000 reactor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Thorium can be utilized in Pressurized Water Reactors (PWR) as ThO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fuel matrix supported by fissile materials. In this analysis, VVER-1000 reactor was taken as a representative of the PWR reactor group. The thorium fuel matrix was mixed with fissile material in form of pure <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">233</sup>U, enriched uranium (19.7 % enrichment) and Reactor-Grade plutonium. Whole fuel cycles were analysed by ANDREA nodal code with diffusion data prepared by HELIOS calculations. Equilibrium fuel loadings were achieved for all fuel composition for four different lengths of fuel loadings reaching from 4×12 months to 5×18 months. The process of reaching the equilibrium loadings, fissile material requirements, and fundamental operational parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Research of transients in induction generator for small-scale wind power in Off-the-Grid by using EMTP - ATP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The article deals with the analysis of transients in induction generator, which operates on small-scale wind power in Off-the-Grid. It deals with issues of self-excited and also deals with transients that are usually occur during the operation of the induction generator. Transients were assessed using a simulation model that was created for this purpose in the EMTP - ATP. The same transients were also measured. The measurements were compared with the results of the simulations.

articleTitle: The electric drive with indirect frequency converter and asynchronous motors with improved immunity against the supply voltage dips
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper solves problematic of immunity against the voltage dips, of the power supply of the electric drive with induction motor supplied from the indirect frequency converter. There are demonstrated the several variants of adaptation of power circuits for achieving a higher immunity against the voltage dips of the power supply. First variant is using of the additional converter in DC-link. Second variant is using of the additional input converter. Third variant is using of active rectifier in place of common used non-controlled rectifier. The paper shows the results of measurement of first variant on laboratory.

Author Keywords: electric drive with voltage sourced inverter

articleTitle: The phase sequence selection for cables lines at Extra High Voltage level
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The article deals with the hygienic limits in the Czech Republic for electric and magnetic fields radiated by Extra High Voltage cables with focus on phase sequence selection for minimization of magnetic fields in the surroundings of cables. Developments in EHV cables domain are discussed as well.

articleTitle: Cooperation of small hydropower plant with wastewater treatment plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The article focuses on utilization possibilities of alternative sources of electricity which are applied to the operation of wastewater treatment plants. These sources would allow to obtain excess energy from wastewater and thus contribute to the creation of a new source of energy. Another option may be seen in the involvement of renewable resources into the operation of the plant and thus reducing the operating costs. The article further focuses on a model of a small hydropower plant realized in the outlet of a wastewater treatment plant. The article also contains an introduction of a small hydropower plant model which is provided with input parameters returns the plant's size and an approximate amount of electricity production from WWTP.

articleTitle: Cherenkov glow analysis by Luminance Distribution Processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Nowadays there are great operational challenges placed on nuclear power plants. It is not only the physical security of the nuclear power plant but it must be guaranteed even against diversion of nuclear fuel and proliferation risk. The spent fuel inspections are the one way to ensuring nonproliferation risk. Inspections are carried out to check the physical presence of fuel assembly. But it also is useful to have tools to detecting fuel assembly or fuel pin manipulation. A typical example is partial defect detection. It was developed several devices for inspections of spent fuel using a Cherenkov glow analysis. These include Scientific Cherenkov viewing device or viewing device with CCD cameras. These devices evaluated Cherenkov glow in the UV spectrum. This article deals with the detection Cherenkov glow in the visible spectrum. This is a new way of using a top LumiDISP measuring system, which was developed for the analysis of the luminance. Spent fuel pool was analyzed by the LumiDISP measuring system and results were compared with fuel assembly's information.

articleTitle: Impact of photovoltaic power plants operation on differential change of distribution grid power
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with description of stochastic production of power in photovoltaic power plants and its impact on the distribution power grid. Stochastic production of power from these sources is characteristic for its hardly predictable and substantially dynamic course. That is due to its strong dependency on weather conditions, especially sunshine. The aim of this survey is to assess the extent, to which these sources may affect changes to the active power at certain points within the power grid.

articleTitle: Measurement of harmonics in low-voltage network on the border between SVK and CZE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with Power Quality (PQ) issue in Low-Voltage (LV) network. It is focused on harmonics' spread and its impact on consumers. The paper introduction concerns with general resources and impacts of the worse Power Quality in network, especially in the area of harmonics. Besides this, it concerns with their occurrence, their superposition and calculation method of Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), but mainly there are standards which apply to Power Quality and are valid in the Slovak Republic. Next part contains data from one-month measurement which was carried out with PQ analyzer in village on the border. The values were chosen from this measurement in the area of harmonics measurement and their impact on consumers in the Czech Republic who are supplied from the Slovak Republic. Measurement values were used for the simulation where the situation is analyzed in detail. The paper includes identified shortcomings and initial recommendations for the power quality improvement in the given area.

articleTitle: Credibility of RCM analysis results
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The Reliability Centred Maintenance can be applied in different ways. The most accuracy approach is full quantitative analysis. The uncertainties of results come especially from input data. The paper is about types of uncertainties and their impact to two main indicators - Savings and Maintenance Efficiency Index. There is shown the probabilistic view on these parameters. The decision making process about maintenance plan need not be as clear as in deterministic view.

articleTitle: The cooperation of fuel cells and renewable energy sources: A short review of operated energetics systems and their main deficiencies of PEMFC models in hybrid systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The hybrid system represents energetic block that consists of individual energy sources. Furthermore, it has other devices that are necessary for reliable operations of the system as a whole. The hybrid system often combines the cooperation of several energy sources which work on different physical principles. Therefore, there are a lot of concepts of hybrid systems in the world nowadays. The review informs about current modelled and used hybrid system concepts in the energetics. Individual concepts can have not only energy sources that produce electricity but also thermal energy sources. Moreover, either the system can be connected to the distribution network or not. The implementation of these energy sources and other devices depends on a specific system concept and its operation requirements. The review is mainly focused on the systems which contain low-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC) cooperating with renewable energy sources in grid-off systems. Deficiencies of PEMFC models are pointed out in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Electrical parameters of water at lightning impulse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with the description of the behavior of water at lightning impulses. The electric potential distribution in water at lightning impulses is simulated for the calculation of the safe distance. There are not hazardous conditions to human body at distances greater than the safe distance. The examples are swimming pools or water where people are bathing. In these simulations is considered a constant conductivity of the water at impulse current of lightning. But conductivity is not constant value, it change over time and with the instantaneous value of the current passing through. So the main benefit of this article is a description of change in the behavior of the water conductivity.

articleTitle: Influence of financial equivalent of supply interruption on decision making in distribution networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with a comparison of an optimal solution of equipping a MV distribution network when different financial equivalents of supply interruption are taken into account. The comparison elicits from the studies performed for real feeders of 22kV overhead lines and is carried out for an optimization task whose objective is allocation of telecontrolled switching elements (telecontrolled section switches and reclosers). The results are presented for a single feeder and for a representative set of real feeders.

articleTitle: Influence of tools setting on processing quality of XLPE core insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with production of the cable core insulation, specifically with insulation extrusion from cross-linking polyethylene (XLPE). It describes an effect of the tools (die and tip) setting on the mechanical properties of the final insulation and its possible degradation during the poor processing. Results of the mechanical properties measurements are discussed.

articleTitle: Study of spent fuel management by transmutation in an accelerator driven subcritical system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Monte Carlo CASCADE version 2004 code is used to simulate the neutron flux inside IAEA benchmark ADS design of a 1500 MW<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> reactor. The reactor is found to have the capability of production of the said amount of thermal energy and has high left over neutron fluence. This n - fluence is equivalent to that of a critical reactor for a given input fuel. Incineration reactions of long lived fission products and long lived trans-uranic actinides are discussed and it is inferred that element like plutonium (239) may be degraded directly in the spallation neutrons close to the spallation target and Low Life Fission Product (LLFP) may better be degraded at later positions where highly thermalized neutrons are available. This stresses upon necessity of producing of an ADS design that accommodates these observations. In any condition, to obtain both energy and possibility of transmutation of the waste, ADS need to operate at criticality (k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> <; 0.98).

articleTitle: Novel nanocomposite DGEBA/TEOS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Polymer materials are the preferred insulating materials for several electrical applications due to their ease of production, light weight and low cost. Modification of basic resin by nanofillers brings another possibility how to modify and improve parameters of these materials, which are widely used in the field of power engineering, especially for insulating systems of electric machines. Polymer nanocomposite exhibit a number of desirable dielectric properties, like increased resistance to partial discharge or a decreased intake of space charges, relative permittivity and dissipation factor. Therefore, novel polymer synthetic nanocomposite DGEBA-Laromin-TEOS was synthesized in order to investigate potential improvement of electrical properties of epoxy resin on addition of Si nanofiller.

articleTitle: The analysis of the measured data of wind turbines Vestas V90 - 2.0 MW
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electricity and its deteriorating quality is increasingly becoming an important problem for the industry and service companies. A significant increase in the production of energy from renewable sources leads to the need to explore new ways of energy systems. It must be known reliability and responsiveness to changes in the network. Power quality and compliance with their parameters indicates the standard ČSN EN 50160. Renewable power sources are unstable and can they ensure a continuous supply constant power. Therefore a project must be connected and operated in such places the electrical system, which will have negative feedback effects on the characteristics of electricity and at the same time will be in accordance with standard ČSN EN 50160.

articleTitle: Stages of development of 110 kV power lines restoration method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper describes 110 kV power lines restoration method based on reliability centered maintenance and its development. The database of faults is used to determine technical condition. The distributed energy and effect of failure are used to determine the importance of line. A functional application was developed to debug the methodology.

articleTitle: Induction generator optimized operation for small-scale wind power in program LabVIEW
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This article discusses a method of determining the optimal operation of the induction machine in generator mode in off-grid. This method of determining the optimum is processed into a program that was created in LabVIEW. This program is able to evaluate the optimal operation of the induction generator in island mode from the calculated parameters of machine and measured characteristics of the machine.

articleTitle: Validation of the TRACE code using PSB-VVER experiments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The TRACE code is a new component-oriented reactor system analysis code designed to analyze light water reactor transients up to the point of significant fuel damage. The TRACE code is the latest in a series of advanced codes developed under the guarantee of U.S. NRC in frame of CAMP (Code Application and Maintenance Program). So the original code validation of the TRACE code was based on experiments performed on experimental facilities of typical PWR design. There are significant differences between PWR and VVER technologies. Therefore the TRACE code validation focused on VVER specific features was expected before its utilization in area of safety analyses in the Czech Republic. The TRACE code validation process is introduced specifically for VVER design using PSB-VVER integral test facility data and real plant data. The selected main results of the TRACE code specific validation are then presented against the PSB-VVER facility LB LOCA experimental test.

articleTitle: Water and temperature influence on polyolefin silane cross-linkined cable insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Nowadays, demand for cables with better thermoplastic properties and flexibility increases. Silanes cross-linking polyolefins on ethylpropylene copolymers, often with increased resistance against fire, sound like suitable new insulation materials types. This paper describes cable properties of this insulation type after temperature stress exposure, stress caused by extreme moisture and changes evaluation of selected samples insulation properties.

articleTitle: Current control techniques for mains connected converters under unbalanced conditions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electric equipments connected to the mains usually consist of a converter, a DC intermediate circuit and an inverter. The power from the mains should be consumed with unity power factor, the mains current should be harmonic, the power flow bidirectional, and also the equipment should be functional under distorted mains conditions. The dual-current control of the converter has been recently developed to meet the mentioned requirements. An overview and comparison of several different control methods are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Investigation of (n,2n) cross sections for some structural materials at 14.0 MeV
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Activation technique was used to measure <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">52</sup>Cr(n,2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">51</sup>Cr, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">55</sup>Mn(n,2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">54</sup>Mn, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">75</sup>As(n,2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">74</sup>As, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">93</sup>Nb(n,2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">92m</sup>Nb, and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">124</sup>Sn(n,2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">123m</sup>Sn reactions at around 14.0 MeV neutron energy. These elements are being used as structural materials in reactor technology. The correction due to the self scattering and self absorption in the samples and pile up effects in the detector was measured experimentally by simulation technique. This technique provides an exact magnitude of corrections experimentally. The experimental cross sections are compared with latest literature data taken from EXFOR database and also with theoretical predictions accounting for nucleon evaporation and preequilibrium emission using hybrid model (ALICE/90) and TALYS-1.4 code over neutron energies from 12 to 16 MeV.

articleTitle: Research of electrophysical properties of oil-paper insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The transformer plays an important role in providing a reliable and efficient electricity supply and is one of the most critical equipment in electric power transmission and distribution systems. The mineral oil paper insulation system is successfully used in transformers for many years. Today great emphasis is accentuated on the use of materials environmentally friendly. Natural ester is considered to be a substitute of mineral oil. This paper is focused on electrophysical properties of rapeseed oil - paper and mineral oil - paper insulation system. Dissipation factor and breakdown voltage of paper impregnated by mineral oil and natural ester were measured. Properties of mineral oil paper insulation and rapeseed oil paper insulation are compared.

articleTitle: Distributed generation and its influence on voltage changes in low voltage grids and transformer loading
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The installed power in distributed generation sources is growing and we record recently more of domestic consumers equipped with the small sources, that operates in low voltage grids. The conception of power supply process is changing from the central production to the decentralization of electricity production. Despite the advantages of distributed generation, the utilities in energy sector have to face also the technical problems that are coming with it. The power system was build to produce the energy in central power plants, to transfer and to distribute it thru long distances to the consumption places in low or medium voltage grids. Radial connection of 22kV power grids, transformers without the remote control of tape changes, harmonics, etc. are the technical barriers for distributed generation. Each source has to meet the technical condition for connection of source to the grid, that are usually set by the relevant distribution system operator. One of the most important condition is the requirement for steady state voltage change. This paper is focused on the analysis of the distribution generation according to the voltage changes in steady state operation and the transformer loading.

articleTitle: A novel ZVZCS half bridge and full bridge DC-DC converter topologies for traction applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new ZVZCS DC-DC converter topologies with modified resonant (CLLC-L & CLL-L) and using with the auxiliary cell are presented in this paper. The proposed converter topologies have ZVS and ZCS soft-switching features. In addition to this the proposed converters feature in high order resonance with improved the overall voltage conversion gain. The soft-switched half bridge and full bridge topologies using medium frequency transformer for traction applications is presented in this paper. The major advantages of proposed topologies are able to increase the switching frequency with reduced switching losses. The detailed operation principles, state space analysis and simulations results are presented.

articleTitle: Vector control implementation of low voltage permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper deals with the vector control of the low voltage permanent magnet synchronous motor. There are described the speed control structure of the AC drive, design of current and speed controllers. Properties of the controllers are verified on a laboratory stand with the AC drive. Experimental results obtained by measurements are discussed. The realized AC drive with low voltage permanent magnet synchronous motor was used as propulsion unit of an electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Voltage analysis of the distribution network with renewable resources using EMTP-ATP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Renewable sources are an integral part of the philosophy of today's power systems. They provide, however, many pitfalls in the form of feedback affecting the operation of the electricity system. The paper describes the analysis of voltage conditions in the power system with a majority share of electricity produced by photovoltaic power plant. There are also described the criteria used to evaluate the connectivity of renewable sources, including their limits.

articleTitle: Measurement of heat pump - statistical data analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Because applications and operation of heat pump, especially air/water type, are connected with problem based on the principle of these heat sources, we designed methods for measuring complete heat pump energy balance. This will allow us clear up real operation characteristic of this type of heat pump and we gained real data for further analysis.

articleTitle: Comparison of economic impacts of safe and dangerous failure of safety system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: People operate many of relatively dangerous equipment such as cars, trains, petrochemical refineries or nuclear power plants. Why human society accepts their processing? The main reason is the benefit that these machineries bring. Their dangerousness is wrongly understood by the general public only as a consequence of a dangerous event, but we know from the theory of dependability and risk controlling that risk is calculated as a combination of more factors, at least of consequences and the expected number of occurrences of unwanted events. This mentioned unwanted event could be a commonly understood failure but also e. g. the false action of a safety system when its impact is not needed (so-called safe failure). The consequence of the false impact is economic loss resulting from process stoppage. The consequence of dangerous failure is mostly expressed by number of lost human lives. However human life can be transferred into financial expression too. People developed more and more reliable machinery to avoid losses of lives. One principle of increasing dependability is to back up the potentially dangerous machinery. This is mostly done by two parallel lines, but there are more options of backuping. This paper deals with three options of back-up algorithms - averaging of three independent signals, voting algorithm 2003 and voting algorithm 2003 with the ability of validation of each signal line. The ratio between safe and dangerous failures depends on the type of back-up. This article deals with the economic evaluation of false impact, dangerous event and the ratio between those two types of faults in dependence on the type of back-up.

articleTitle: STATCOM effect on voltage stability in Ghanaian electrical grid
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with using STATCOM for voltage stability purposes which is analyzed on the Ghanaian power system development. Preliminary studies have shown that the northern sector is vulnerable to voltage instability which has led to the proposed installation of STATCOM in a key substation Tamale. It is therefore necessary to assess the performance of the device when put in operation. Comparison had therefore been made between the use of STATCOM and a fixed compensator. Line and generator contingencies as well as small signal disturbances analysis have been carried out. Voltage stability is improved with the installation of STATCOM but do not affect the interconnection between Ghana and Burkina Faso. Further evaluation focused on the inter-tie is proposed.

articleTitle: Inductive sensor usage for partial discharge measurements on high voltage coils
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper describes experiments of partial discharge measurements made by linear and toroid sensors on high voltage coils. The aim of this work is to observe partial discharge development in dependence of insulation system quality and how it influences reliability device.

articleTitle: Fault tree analysis of emergency core cooling system and containment spray system of WWER440/V213
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Paper is presenting a fault tree analysis of emergency core cooling system and containment spray system of nuclear power plant with WWER 440/V213 reactor. Importance analysis is performed for vital components and support systems.

articleTitle: Techno-economic analysis of different battery storage suitable for Off-Grid systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Off-Grid systems are used in remote areas, hamlets, caravans, chalets, which are far from the grid, or if the connection was very difficult and economically costly. Such systems operate independently without external power. As a source of power energy are used photovoltaic and small wind power plants installed capacities to generate electricity for their own use. The produced power energy is accumulated in the accumulator. Therefore, the batteries are one of the most important and most expensive part of the Off -Grid system and it is necessary to take into account in the design. The price of batteries is approximately 50% of all costs on an Off -Grid system.

articleTitle: New solutions in transmission and distribution network in frame Renewable Portfolio Standards
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The following article was based on the Ministry of Economy which created the project “Polish Energy Policy until 2030”. The document sets out the basic objectives and actions to be implemented in the energy sector in late 2010 to 2030. Paper add also the new possibility in infrastructure of network it the article one presented the proposal for wider use of smart wires in transmission and distribution network.

articleTitle: Support of peripheral areas in the Moravian-Silesian region using micro-hydroelectric power plants
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with the possibilities of energy use of small watercourses that would allow supplying adjacent infrastructure or tourist facilities through small hydroelectric power plants sufficiently enough for these facilities to be comfortable tourist locations and allow creating an attractive environment. It deals with the concepts of small hydroelectric power plants to supply local micro-grid networks using solid state inverters, storage structures and cheap pump turbines.

articleTitle: Optimal design of neural tree for solar power prediction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Today renewable energy sources are integral part of energy mix in most of countries in the world. Carbon reduction issues and other ecological activity provide a wide possibility to progressive increase of installed capacity of renewable energy sources. Huge distribution of instable renewable energy sources like wind and photovoltaic plants brings new tasks in power system control and power system reliability. Prediction of power production is one of the ways to mitigate negative impact of operation of instable energy sources. This work presents application of a neural tree method from the group of soft computing method for renewable energy prediction. In this work we focus on photovoltaic power plant production prediction.

articleTitle: Distribution of wind power plants to reduce variability of renewable generation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: As the penetration of wind power into generation mix increases, the issue of its integration into the power grid becomes more and more important. The variability of wind power generation is a major concern as wind is highly intermittent. This may result in significant overproduction at times, followed by complete unavailability of wind power at other periods. This intermittency must be compensated for by other, conventional generation sources such as coal and gas fired power plants. This reduces the overall efficiency of the system due to the need of running some generators as spinning reserves, and lowers the overall contribution of renewable generation to the mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions. This paper examines the possibility to optimize the spatial distribution of wind power plants over an extended area to decrease the overall variability of wind power generation in a system. In particular, it considers the integration of spatially distributed wind power generation in the wind-rich province of Alberta, Canada. The distribution of power plants is optimized using simulated annealing and quadratic programming. The results clearly show that the variability of wind power generation can be reduced if the wind resources are integrated over a wide geographic area.

articleTitle: Voltage regulation optimization in low voltage network based on Voltage Quality Index
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper deals with an optimization procedure in terms of a network voltage parameters improvement. A software based approach is used to select optimal type of voltage regulator, its power and ideal location for application in a Low-Voltage (LV) test network, where it is required to enhance Voltage Quality (VQ). The test network presents a case where application of on-load tap changer transformer instead of conventional distribution transformer MV/LV is not adequate to maintain voltage profile in the LV system in limits. Therefore other type of voltage regulator has to be employed to increase VQ in the entire LV network. Principal measure for VQ evaluation there is adopted a Voltage Quality Index expressing the VQ level in dependence on selected and specified input parameters, which may be voltage magnitude, unbalance, harmonic distortion, flicker level and frequency. Within optimization process, maximal current carrying capacity of lines, network losses and cost of solutions are also taken into account.

articleTitle: Analysis of transformer state by fuzzy TOPSIS and AHP method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents mathematical models TOPSIS and AHP methods, which was utilized on insulating state of distribution transformer to analyze and sensibility of individual measurements methods mutual comparison. We can uniquely determine the importance of these measurements methods with this mathematical apparatus in these measurements methods in insulating state of transformers.

articleTitle: The protection and the control of a small Off-Grid system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: nowadays, runs an intensive research in development area of energy system with specific requirements, so-called SMART-Grid and Off-Grid. Researchers deal with this phenomenon at several levels across the spectrum, e.g. in scientific research teams, commercial teams and private sector - represented by multinational companies and investments groups. Specific requirements include energy independence of external power supply, operation with equally generation-consumption balance, maximal utilization of renewable energy sources and utilization of the energy storage covering the energy deficit and vice versa. In most cases is generally discussing only the benefits and proactive development direction of these concepts, but as usually with every product, there is no longer mentions the issues of the operations in long time term. The goal of this paper is to point out the operation issues of SMART-Grid and Off-Grid systems with specific requirements, especially with regard to the protection methods and abnormal operating conditions as well as the possibility of using a Multiagent system for the management and the control of a small Off-Grid system.

articleTitle: Dielectric spectroscopy of transformer oil based ferrofluid from view of i(t) characteristics at initial stage of ageing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The article deals with thermal ageing of transformer oil based ferrofluid at initial stage of ageing. Influence of ageing in this article observes changes caused by polarization current, which triggers structural changes in liquid insulation. Except the influence of ageing of polarization current on these samples it has to be noted, that concentration of magnetic nanoparticles in these fluids can also affects capacitance of samples. This assumption is confirmed in article.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of solid oxide fuel cell's basic operational characteristic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The technology of fuel cells and mainly the solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC) is still subject to a fairly intense development for its unforgettable competitive advantage, the opportunity to use relatively cheap and accessible hydrocarbon fossil fuels or other synthetic fuels containing hydrogen molecules. These fuel cells are mainly intended for application in power systems for combined production of electric power and heat (co-generation) or for an additional production of electric power to improve the energetic balance of other power technologies. Technologies proven through experiments and procedures employed in production of SOFC fuel cells have shown sound operating parameters during laboratory testing and these will be prepared for application into actual power equipment within a medium-term horizon, for gradual commercialisation and even preparation for serial production, according to some optimistic perspectives. The contents of this paper should bring a closer look onto the technology of fuel cells, the SOFC type fuel cells respectively, their basic topology, operating principle and the last but not the least would be the presentation of procedures implemented in application and results of testing of a specific prototype design of a high-temperature tubular SOFC fuel cell.

articleTitle: Accelerator driven p(37)-D2O fast neutron source at NPI Řeř
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2014 15th International Scientific Conference on Electric Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In the article, the fundamental information on the neutron production in the D(p,n)2p reaction is summarized, and the measurements at research facilities dealing with such types of source are described. The details about the experimental study of p + D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and p + D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O reactions and corresponding neutron source development at the NPI in Řeř are provided. The accelerator driven fast neutron generator NG-2 based on p(37) + D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O source reaction with a broad neutron spectrum up to 34 MeV is characterized, and the neutron field determined by the multi-foil activation technique validated against the Monte Carlo MCNPX calculations is presented. The research programs realized in this neutron field, commonly used for experimental simulation of the IFMIF (International Fusion Material Irradiation Facility) spectrum, are outlined.
